name: The Black Stair
note: flood basalt stepping down off the Forge into four neighbouring biomes; Slate stands in until RM_Basalt exists

name: The Salt Knolls
note: limestone caprock over salt plugs in the Salt region; RM_SaltRock is a proposed new stone (card 2 list) and needs its own ruling and art

name: Starfall Rim
note: impact-shocked crystalline rock on the Cratercrown rim of the Scald crater; any meteoric metal is a mineral-matrix row (MINERAL_MATRIX_DESIGN_ROUND_TWO_SPARSER) not a stone

name: The Hullbed
note: the Rust Cathedral's buried deck plate surfacing in Warscar and four other biomes outside the cathedral; its Steel yield is a mineral-matrix row (MINERAL_MATRIX_DESIGN_ROUND_TWO_SPARSER)

name: The Chalk Step
note: one white chalk bed cut across four twilight biomes in the Chalk Marches; a one-stone map on purpose

name: The Coldstone Shield
note: night-side granite upland in the Coldstone region with ice in its joints; SolidIce is Odyssey's and biome-specific so only this landmark carries it into the Abyss
